name: domiciledb
description: Self-hosted home inventory built to prove what you owned and get paid after a disaster.

comments.types-node: @types/node tracks the RUNTIME Node major (24: CI setup-node, Dockerfile builder node:24 and distroless nodejs24), not the newest types major — newer types would let code reference APIs the deployed runtime doesn't have. Take Renovate's @types/node major only together with the runtime bump.
comments.overrides: Security floors are RANGES (^), never exact pins: npm applies an override verbatim, so an exact version is a ceiling that holds the tree on a known-vulnerable release (brace-expansion@5 sat on 5.0.8 after 5.0.9 shipped for exactly this reason). The @emnapi/* entries below are the one exception and stay exact on purpose. Pin @emnapi/* (optional+peer wasm deps from sharp/transitive) to consistent versions; works around an npm bug where the lockfile writer and `npm ci` validator disagree, which otherwise breaks `npm ci` in CI and Docker. brace-expansion@5 floors at ^5.0.9 for GHSA-mh99-v99m-4gvg (unbounded expand() output -> uncatchable OOM); sharp is floored at its fixed release for GHSA-f88m-g3jw-g9cj (libvips runtime CVEs), and that override also lifts next's bundled 0.34.x copy past the vuln. The former brace-expansion@1 floor (GHSA-3jxr-9vmj-r5cp, plus an osv-scanner suppression for the unfixable 1.x line) left with ESLint -- nothing in the tree depends on the 1.x line anymore.
